VERDICT: bench damage during the pull (bright unoxidized copper along the peel + freshly-reflowed domed solder on vacated pads + chip-on-a-hair could not have survived the unit's history). Pre-existing-video-break theory DEAD; the 07-06 one-software-fault parsimony STANDS. Lesson: kapton/foil small DFNs in the nozzle wash before pulling connectors. SP3010 recoverable as free spare (snip free, verify top-mark vs intact twin EG8B7, check held pin for ridden copper). Trace-repair log docs/microsoldering/eg8b6-trace-repair-0017-2.md.
